title: LONGi Solar releases new solar module Hi-MO2, starting a new era of high efficiency mono PERC bifacial technology
lineage: Original manufacturer announcement on its English-language site.

passages.locator: Opening paragraph and Hi-MO2 product and production paragraphs
passages.note: The 19 April unveiling occurred at SNEC in Shanghai. Hi-MO2 was built around monocrystalline bifacial PERC cells, with a glass rear package admitting light and prior low light-induced degradation technology from Hi-MO1. LONGi reported that the 365 W version had reached mass production by the time of the announcement.

file.representation: paraphrased research notes and selected factual observations
